bio_50_words: Assoc. Prof. Mohamed El-Sakka directs the Mechatronics & Automation Engineering program and the Engineering programs at EPNU, and leads its International Relations Office. A Port Said University mechanical power engineer with a PhD from the University of Sheffield, he researches wind energy, CFD and optimisation of renewable energy systems.
